2.50.24
Matrix.CellDataElementName
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
The Matrix.CellDataElementName element specifies the name to use for the data element of each
instance of the cell that contains the detail data of a Matrix in a data rendering. The
Matrix.CellDataElementName element is optional. If this element is present, its value MUST be a
CLS-compliant identifier [UTR15]. If this element is not present, its value is interpreted as "Cell".
Following is the parent element of the Matrix.CellDataElementName element.
Parent elements
Matrix
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Matrix.CellDataElementName element.
 <xsd:element name="CellDataElementName" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0" />
